question: What is the revenue from Canada in 2020?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(gl.amount) as revenue FROM general_ledger gl JOIN chart_of_accounts coa ON gl.organization_id = coa.organization_id AND gl.account_key = coa.account_key JOIN territory t ON gl.organization_id = t.organization_id AND gl.territory_key = t.territory_key JOIN calendar c ON gl.date = c.date WHERE coa.class = 'Revenue' AND t.country = 'Canada' AND c.year = 2020 AND gl.organization_id = 1

question: What is the revenue growth rate from 2019 to 2021?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN c.year = 2021 THEN gl.amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN c.year = 2019 THEN gl.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN c.year = 2019 THEN gl.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as growth_rate FROM general_ledger gl JOIN chart_of_accounts coa ON gl.organization_id = coa.organization_id AND gl.account_key = coa.account_key JOIN calendar c ON gl.date = c.date WHERE coa.class = 'Revenue' AND gl.organization_id = 1
